anomalies.observed: On the root sheet the Tag-Connect header J1 pin 3 (RESET) carries the label NET0016, the same net that connects J1 pin 6 (SWO) to MCU pin 52 (PB3). The MCU NRST pin 7 sits on a different net, NET0018, which only goes to the R5 10k pull-up and has no connection to J1.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the programming interface's ~{RESET} line must be joined to the MCU reset: 'R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC ... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.' J1 pin 3 should be on the NRST net (NET0018), and the SWO net (NET0016) should carry only J1 pin 6 / PB3.

Root sheet: MCU U3 pin 7 NRST label = NET0018; pin 52 PB3 label = NET0016
Reset line: R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC ... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.

anomalies.impact: The debug/programmer reset line is shorted to the SWO trace instead of the MCU reset pin. The Tag-Connect cannot assert NRST (so hardware reset via the programmer fails), and the SWO output is tied to the RESET pin, which can conflict with the SWO signal and prevent reliable SWD programming.
